## Hi there 👋

I'm a second-year BEng Computer Science student at Anglia Ruskin University in Cambridge. I enjoy building things to understand them better, and I'm currently focused on learning how computers work at a lower level, particularly through systems programming, computer architecture, and embedded computing.

<img src="output/bonsai.gif" alt="My Git Bonsai, grown from GitHub contributions" width="256" height="256" align="right" />

## On the workbench 🔧

- [**Murmur:**](https://github.com/george-cliff/murmur) Exploring offline bird call detection using machine learning on low powered hardware, aimed at remote areas where Wi-Fi or mobile data may not be available.
- [**Triarch:**](https://github.com/george-cliff/triarch-compute-sim) Experimenting with RISC-V processor emulators in C, C++, and Rust, using a Python harness to compare their performance, verify them against a SystemVerilog model, and understand the trade-offs between the languages.
- [**Atlas:**](https://github.com/george-cliff/atlas-homelab) A Debian home server built from salvaged PC parts, running self-hosted services including Nextcloud, Immich, and my own private Git server, with encrypted off-site backups.

<div style="clear: both;"></div>

## Contact me 📬

I'm excited to put what I've been learning into practice through an internship, contribute to open-source projects, and learn from other developers. I'm always happy to chat, so if you'd like to learn more about me or get in touch, the badges at the top link to my website, CV, LinkedIn, and email.
